{{Quote|Colim, Lye-em ... your people are ready?|[[Parx]]|<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Dorumaa's Children]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref>}}
'''Lye-em''' was an individual who worked as poacher for [[Rufus Trammel]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="date" /> After Trammel's poachers captured the [[Dorumaan leviathan]], [[Jessel]], the poacher [[Parx]] asked Lye-em if some of the other poachers were ready to load the creature onto Trammel's [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
